entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-07-25
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • VS Ide and dotnet command line different behaviour on <EnableDefaultCompileItems>false</EnableDefaultCompileItems> #49939
    Discussion
  • Platform/RuntimeIdentifier clashes #49935
    Discussion
  • Feature Request: Add ForceRebuild attribute to <Watch> items for non-C# source file changes during hot reload #49934

Closed

  • Request for a Lightweight .NET-Only IDE (Non-GUI Focused) #49762
  • [NETSDKE2E] [Regression] Unable to search NuGet package in VS Code. #49765
  • Please remove annoying preview message #49776
  • Fiddler (local HTTPS MITM) no longer seeks .NET SDK traffic, .NET SDK rejects certificate #49811
  • SdkResolver may need to set DOTNET_ROOT in order for framework-dependent processes inside an IDE to run correctly #49825
  • Deprecate -d on dotnet tool install --create-manifest-if-needed #49880
  • Update GitHub bug template to use details for `dotnet --info` request #49912
  • "dotnet build" fails to produce a runnable binary if used after a self-contained publish with ArtifactsPath #49582
  • MSB4018 on Blazor WASM with .NET 9.0.300 #49039
  • Runtime version should be part of file-based app cache #49478
  • `dotnet package add System.Memory@4.6.3` says `Build succeeded` #49921
  • Support launch profile configuration file named [ApplicationName].run.json in the app root #48200
    10.0.1xx
  • LinkedList Alternative #49933
  • [NETSDKE2E][Regression]Redundant messages are displayed in terminal output when running .NET 10.0 project. #48823
